title: BIVLC: Extending Vision-Language Compositionality Evaluation with Text-to-Image Retrieval

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating models on bidirectional vision-language compositionality tasks (image-to-text and text-to-image retrieval) using hard negative pairs to penalize models that rely on unimodal language priors or LLM decoder artifacts rather than true multimodal understanding.

Training binary classification detectors to distinguish between natural and synthetic images/texts, and evaluating whether models perform well on the benchmark merely by detecting synthetic artifacts rather than learning compositionality.
